title: How I feel about #IndieWeb and HTML
summary: Nobody's got a thing against you Unless you've got something to prove We don't need no set of standards We don't need a new set of rules Heard all that shit before, about stomping out any difference We say stand together, (Not to fight just to exist) Operation Ivy-Take Warning
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Nobody's got a thing against you
Unless you've got something to prove 
We don't need no set of standards
We don't need a new set of rules 
Heard all that shit before, 
about stomping out any difference 
We say stand together, 
(Not to fight just to exist)

Operation Ivy-Take Warning
